privacy: No private filenames, paths, contents, preference keys/values, individual file hashes, column names, or row values are emitted; known app schema table names only.
sqlite_policy: Database plus WAL/SHM/journal are copied to a temporary directory before every SQLite open. Original backups are read only as bytes.
row_policy: Every baseline table is compared as a typed row hash multiset over every baseline non-hidden column, including generated columns. New columns/rows are allowed. No path, timestamp, JSON, or content normalization.
material_policy: Common document/media extensions and all nonhidden course files outside internal .bandal state; learning storage is separately compared byte for byte.
scope_note: Content-preservation status excludes mutable metadata and unrelated operational state. Their full row and file differences remain visible as counts. Missing backup domains mean unverified, never preserved. ShareInbox requires its all_files result for byte-preservation claims.
